note: FIX37 Axis-B closed-set candidate pool. 100% synthetic. Each re-identification question shows the TRUE profile plus 9 deterministically-chosen distractors => random chance is exactly 1/10 = 10%.
construct_rule: A card carries name | role | area | detail. For a message tagged quasi_strong=true the role/area DELIBERATELY match the quasi-identifiers the message states in the clear — that is the effect being measured. For quasi_strong=false the role/area/detail are unrelated to that message's subject, so once the PII is masked the card is unreachable and accuracy should collapse toward chance. Cards must never restate the message's topic: the first draft of this file did (a 'solar panel' detail against a solar-panel message), which made topic-matching look like re-identification. Details are therefore non-topical facts only (tenure, membership tier).
